title: Probe, Don't Prompt: A Hidden-State Probe for Metadata Filtering in Multi-Meta-RAG
abstract: arXiv:2607.03929v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-Meta-RAG improves retrieval for multi-hop question answering by filtering a vector store on metadata, specifically the news source and the publication date, which it extracts from each query using GPT-3.5. This extractor requires a proprietary API call for every query, and its output is not restricted to the allowed sources: even though the prompt specifies 49 sources, GPT-3.5 generates 128 distinct source names, 79 of which do not appear on the list. We show that the source part of this extractor can be replaced by a local, deterministic probe trained on the hidden states of a small open-source language model. The probe is a multi-label logistic classifier on the mean-pooled hidden states of one layer, trained with a class-balanced loss on the gold evidence sources. Using 5-fold cross-validation to select the layer, we evaluate four models ranging from 135M to 1.5B parameters out-of-fold across all 2556 MultiHop-RAG quer

translated_title: 探测而非提示：用于Multi-Meta-RAG元数据过滤的隐藏状态探针
translated_abstract: Multi-Meta-RAG通过在元数据（具体为新闻来源和发布日期）上过滤向量存储来改进多跳问答的检索效果，这些元数据由GPT-3.5从每个查询中提取。该提取器需要对每个查询进行专有API调用，且其输出并不受允许来源列表的约束：尽管提示中指定了49个来源，GPT-3.5却生成了128个不同的来源名称，其中79个不在列表之内。我们证明，该提取器的来源部分可以由一个本地、确定性的探针替代，该探针在小型开源语言模型的隐藏状态上训练得到。该探针是作用于某一层均值池化隐藏状态的多标签逻辑回归分类器，使用类别平衡损失在黄金证据来源上训练。通过5折交叉验证来选择层，我们在全部2556个MultiHop-RAG查询上对参数量从135M到1.5B的四个模型进行了折外评估。
tldr: 该论文提出用小型开源语言模型隐藏状态上训练的本地确定性多标签探针，替代Multi-Meta-RAG中基于GPT-3.5的新闻来源元数据提取器，从而免去专有API调用并将输出严格限制在允许的来源列表内。
en_tdlr: A local, deterministic multi-label probe trained on the hidden states of a small open-source language model can replace GPT-3.5-based news source extraction in Multi-Meta-RAG, eliminating proprietary API calls while constraining outputs to the allowed source list.
